title: Blackhawk near-miss with low-flying F-4 Phantom
place_text: Germany, near the Rhine River valley

tellings.quote: Jesus, we nearly died because of what that F4 pilot had done.

plain: Greg Rogers, a doctor who served as an Army flight surgeon, a doctor who flies with and looks after aircrews, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a flight in Germany near the Rhine River valley. He says he was in a Blackhawk, an Army helicopter, when an F-4 Phantom fighter jet came through flying very low. Rogers says they nearly died because of what the jet's pilot had done.
